lines.text: The stone that signed this tablet seems lost. Its signature isn't.
Five thousand years ago, someone had to track barley.
So signs were drawn in wet clay, probably for a handout.
So they pressed round marks: numbers.
A carved stone seal, rolled across like a signature.
A man leading leashed dogs after wild boars in a marsh.
Among the earliest writing known, and mostly record-keeping.
The stone's gone. The picture stays.
